eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric & Real-Time Analytics · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 26 · Real-Time Data Engineering

code:
| summarize TripCount = count() by bin(pickup_time, 5m)  -- 5-min
| summarize TripCount = count() by bin(pickup_time, 1h)  -- hourly
| summarize TripCount = count() by bin(pickup_time, 1d)  -- daily
caption: Choosing the right bucket size is a real, practical decision.

code:
RawTripEvents
| where pickup_time > ago(1h)

# "One hour before THIS query actually runs" --
# recalculates every time. Never a fixed timestamp.
caption: The real mechanism behind a live "last hour" dashboard view.

eyebrow: make-series — real time series, not just grouped counts
code:
RawTripEvents
| make-series TripCount = count() on pickup_time
    from ago(6h) to now() step 15m

# Fills in EVERY interval -- including genuine zeros.
caption: summarize/bin silently omits empty buckets. make-series doesn't.
